crates.name: latticeaxiom-abi
crates.v1_role: Portable Native ABI 0.1 wire layouts, validators, and staged-write recovery policy for trusted in-process portable modules.
crates.notes: Engine-independent; v1 is not ABI 1.0. Keep generated C/Rust layouts as the sole layout source. Does not load libraries or wrap Bevy types. A later loader/SDK consumes these DTOs; do not add a parallel ABI crate.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-client-ui
crates.v1_role: Bevy-independent semantic view models and interaction drafts for the HUD, inventory, crafting, inspect, loading, and overlays.
crates.notes: Generic platform crate owned by the host UI boundary. It is the compatibility bridge from package-authored shell, presentation, and settings data to the Bevy adapter, but owns no App, renderer, input authority, gameplay authority, or package-specific catalog.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-compose
crates.v1_role: Nickel-evaluated composition DTOs, trusted source-table staging, worker protocol, settings/observability catalogs, and product-lock inputs.
crates.notes: Extend to production worker containment, source-table-only evaluation, and final latticeaxiom.lock receipts. compose::WorldHeader is a catalog/durability projection, not the v1 playable world-session contract. Do not add a parallel composition crate.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-content
crates.v1_role: Engine-independent D9 compiler for block, fluid, biome, Role, and stable-ID palette contracts.
crates.notes: Authored Terrenia rows stay in packages. fixtures/terrenia is test data, not a duplicate package. Do not copy catalogs into host crates or invent a second content compiler.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-core
crates.v1_role: Stable identifiers, canonical JSON hashing, provenance, and namespace grants for process-external boundaries.
crates.notes: Already the typed-newtype boundary for manifests, locks, persistence, and ABI metadata. Do not introduce a second identity crate.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-dual-fixture
crates.v1_role: Package-local D1 static-versus-portable dual-realization conformance fixture for one gameplay row kernel.
crates.notes: The Cargo crate now lives inside the logical package source root and participates in source inclusion. It remains transitional evidence: the portable behavior harness does not load native libraries, and an rlib is not the final lock-specific NativeStatic product executable.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-engine
crates.v1_role: Receipt-verified Bevy App owner (EngineInstance) for client DefaultPlugins and GPU-free headless MinimalPlugins from a prepared RuntimeImage.
crates.notes: Integrate the package-driven production spine here. The playable module is a finite in-memory development fixture (hard-coded Terrenia identifiers, entity-per-block presentation, non-durable authority): adapt it only as interaction smoke, then reduce or remove after the production spine; it is not the production world host. run_temporary_client_presentation_fixture is likewise not a production path. Do not create a parallel host crate.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-gameplay
crates.v1_role: Host-agnostic sandbox kernel for inventory, mining, tools, recipes, drops, placement, and authoritative transactions.
crates.notes: GameplayKernel and GameplayPlanV1 are integrated by the production host, which applies bounded plans to loaded chunks and commits through the storage transaction boundary. This crate remains the generic mechanics owner: Terrenia rules and tools stay package-authored, ReferencePlanApplier is not a storage receipt, and durable world codecs remain outside this crate.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-input
crates.v1_role: Package-local typed action catalog, binding profile, input context, and headless logical-input contracts.
crates.notes: The Cargo crate is colocated with the logical @latticeaxiom/input package while retaining its independent latticeaxiom-input crate name. Workspace dependency inheritance is a compile-time compatibility bridge; the package realization remains data-only until a frozen, receipt-injected native dependency closure exists.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-launcher
crates.v1_role: Fail-closed process-transition, LaunchIntentV1, and single-use client App lease boundary.
crates.notes: Extend to drive profile acquisition, resolution, registration compilation, RuntimeImage, and client/headless boot from a reopened final lock. Does not create a Bevy App. Do not add a parallel launcher crate.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-packages
crates.v1_role: Deterministic package resolver producing pre-build resolution receipts from evaluated composition DTOs.
crates.notes: The current receipt is not latticeaxiom.lock. Complete local CAS acquisition, artifact/toolchain/engine receipts, and atomic lock persist in this kernel. Do not add a second resolver.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-player
crates.v1_role: Fixed-tick player movement, optional Leafwing input adapter, and authoritative block-edit request DTOs.
crates.notes: Keep PlayerActionFrameV1 independent of Avian and Leafwing. Integrate the 5 m reach interface with latticeaxiom-voxel-runtime DDA rather than a new controller crate. Deferred D2 hardening stays in this crate.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-registration
crates.v1_role: Deterministic compilation of locked-graph registration images and semantic, layout, callback, and provenance receipts.
crates.notes: Freeze registration_semantic_hash and callback-map hash into the lock and bind CompiledRegistration before any callback runs. Semantic image here is a compiled registration fingerprint, not the v1 world-session field. Do not add a parallel compiler.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-render-contracts
crates.v1_role: Device-independent D5 render-plan, provider-selection, and portable command contracts.
crates.notes: Presentation receipts never change world hash. The Bevy host maps semantic slots; do not add a project-owned renderer facade.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-runtime-contracts
crates.v1_role: Pure-data validation, binding, local persistence, and apply-transaction contracts for graph-selected settings plus observability catalogs.
crates.notes: Operates on latticeaxiom-compose DTOs. Settings and observability are selected by graph capabilities. Local user/device settings use the canonical old-or-complete-new publication protocol here; world persistence remains outside this crate. It owns no Bevy App, UI, renderer, or callback runtime.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-sdk
crates.v1_role: Code-bound registration IR, static adapter plans, and portable batch shims.
crates.notes: Share system-signature/callback contracts with registration instead of parallel DTOs. This crate neither loads nor calls native libraries. Do not add a second SDK.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-sdk-macros
crates.v1_role: Proc macros for the sealed component and system registration IR.
crates.notes: Keep as the only registration-IR macro crate. Pair with latticeaxiom-sdk; do not invent a second macro surface.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-settings-ui
crates.v1_role: Typed settings catalog projection, transaction surface, and accessibility contracts for client and tools.
crates.notes: The Cargo crate is colocated with the logical @latticeaxiom/settings-ui package while retaining its independent latticeaxiom-settings-ui crate name. Its platform dependencies resolve through workspace contracts; the package realization remains data-only until native build trust is explicitly authorized.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-start-ui
crates.v1_role: Headless semantic contracts for the client shell, world library, create/continue, loading stages, settings, and launch handoff.
crates.notes: The Cargo crate is colocated with the logical @latticeaxiom/front-end package while retaining its independent latticeaxiom-start-ui crate name. Contains no renderer; an engine-client adapter may project into Bevy UI. Do not add a parallel shell crate.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-storage
crates.v1_role: Sealed materialized-chunk transaction kernel and non-durable MemoryTransactionKernel reference.
crates.notes: Not the complete D3 WorldStorage boundary. V2 may use memory behind production interfaces without claiming durability. Add typed metadata, requirement closure, wire envelope, and a physical backend in this kernel family, not a parallel storage crate.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-terrenia-worldgen
crates.v1_role: Terrenia-owned world-generation profiles, terrain presets, and biome policy.
crates.notes: Package-local policy crate for @terrenia/worldgen. It resolves Terrenia defaults into generic latticeaxiom-worldgen contracts without moving package policy into the engine or generic worldgen crate.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-territory
crates.v1_role: D7 Territory Atlas, cave-topology, hydrology, portal, and planning-cell epoch contracts.
crates.notes: Complete the v1 three-surface and two-underground atlas here. Does not generate voxels or open writers. latticeaxiom-worldgen currently uses only the TerritoryQueryV1 shape; do not fork a second atlas crate. VerticalRangeV1 is not a world-session field.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-voxel-mesh
crates.v1_role: CPU greedy meshing and face culling from padded chunks with revision receipts.
crates.notes: Production derived-mesh path. Callers compare MeshReceipt before apply. Do not mesh on the frame-critical path or treat playable entity-per-block presentation as production.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-voxel-playground
crates.v1_role: Discardable bevy_voxel_world presentation and streaming sink with revision-gated projection.
crates.notes: Not authority, DDA, or saves. Keep one-way ProjectionBatch/RevisionGate; never read the upstream HashMap back. Production rendering uses chunk mesh batches plus this ecosystem sink, not a second voxel-authority crate and not the playable entity-per-block model.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-voxel-runtime
crates.v1_role: Bounded working-set, mesh/collider queues, stale-result rejection, and 5 m Y-up DDA over committed voxels.
crates.notes: Cannot author edits or advance storage revisions. Integrate with the production chunk lifecycle and Bevy task pools here; do not add a parallel working-set crate.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-world-catalog
crates.v1_role: World-library identity, sidecar header, open preflight, trash/restore, and activation-plan contracts (ADR 0027).
crates.notes: WorldHeaderV1 is a catalog/durability projection, not the v1 playable world-session contract. Sealed catalog-to-writer receipts remain blocked until authorized. Do not add a parallel catalog crate.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-world-db
crates.v1_role: Fail-closed world-persistence boundary and volatile DeterministicWorldStorage reference.
crates.notes: Keep ActivationEvidenceUnavailable until a sealed catalog receipt exists. Do not open a writer or claim RocksDB/WAL/restart durability. A physical backend later belongs in this crate, not a bypass or a second persistence crate.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-world-wire
crates.v1_role: Portable world-wire@1 chunk-record keys, snapshot envelopes, and persisted-chunk codec.
crates.notes: WORLD-01/WORLD-06 foundation plus PersistedChunkSnapshotV1. Still not a complete ChunkSnapshotV1 palette/bit-packing envelope. WorldWireLimits are codec clamps, not v1 world-session host clamps. Do not invent a second wire crate.

crates.name: latticeaxiom-worldgen
crates.v1_role: Deterministic D4 generation scaffold: seed, config, providers, cave fields, epochs, and snapshot-first candidates.
crates.notes: Algorithm scaffold only; workers never open storage or publish chunks. Complete the Terrenia coordinator, streaming, cave, hydrology, and spawn pipeline here. WorldSeedV1 and GenerationEpochIdV1 are not world-session header fields. Do not move Terrenia defaults into this crate.

packages.name: @example/dual-gameplay
packages.v1_role: Data-only shipped conformance package for the package-local gameplay implementation's static-versus-portable equivalence fixtures.
packages.notes: The colocated Cargo crate, benches, and tests are development evidence included in the source snapshot, not executable package realizations. The shipped package exposes only its nonempty tests/fixtures DataRoot at data-only trust; workspace dependency inheritance is a compile-time compatibility bridge.

packages.name: @latticeaxiom/dev-tools
packages.v1_role: Optional graph-selected developer workbench (debug-workbench capability).
packages.notes: Owns a package-purpose descriptor and the client/tool debug-workbench capability. It is omitted from headless unless selected and contains no Terrenia defaults or host fallback implementation.

packages.name: @latticeaxiom/front-end
packages.v1_role: Package-driven client shell root aggregating world-library, settings-ui, and observability.
packages.notes: Code-bearing package source root for start/create/continue/loading semantics. Cargo.toml, src, and tests participate in source inclusion; executable SourceBuild selection still requires an explicitly trusted, receipt-closed build policy. Do not hide Terrenia in this package.

packages.name: @latticeaxiom/input
packages.v1_role: Typed action catalog, bindings, input contexts, compilation, and headless logical-input contracts.
packages.notes: Owns its Rust crate, canonical action-catalog data, package manifests, and tests in one source root. Its shipped realization remains data-only; workspace dependency inheritance is the compile-time compatibility bridge and does not authorize a native package build.

packages.name: @latticeaxiom/inspect
packages.v1_role: Optional client target-inspect surface over the diagnostic registry.
packages.notes: Owns a package-purpose descriptor and target-inspect capability. It is graph-selected; headless may omit it without changing authoritative registration or world hash.

packages.name: @latticeaxiom/observability
packages.v1_role: Exactly-one diagnostic-registry provider for client, headless, and tool profiles.
packages.notes: Owns the graph-selected diagnostic-registry capability and its package-purpose data. The host consumes the selected locked artifact and must not select this provider by package-name fallback.

packages.name: @latticeaxiom/progress
packages.v1_role: Generic authoritative/client progress-graph capability and canonical graph data.
packages.notes: Platform package owning progress graph data, not Terrenia chapters. Content packages such as @terrenia/journey depend on this capability rather than embedding a second progress runtime.

packages.name: @latticeaxiom/relations
packages.v1_role: Generic authoritative relation-kind graph and relations-graph capability.
packages.notes: Platform data package for typed relationships between content identities. It owns generic relation kinds; game-specific relation rows remain in their content packages.

packages.name: @latticeaxiom/settings
packages.v1_role: Exactly-one settings-registry provider for client, headless, and tool profiles.
packages.notes: Owns the canonical user settings catalog, including the requested 2..32 chunk view-distance range. The graph selects this provider and the host reports admitted/effective limits; UI and host must not duplicate the catalog or silently narrow its authored range.

packages.name: @latticeaxiom/settings-ui
packages.v1_role: Client/tool settings surface over the settings registry.
packages.notes: Owns its Rust implementation, authored vocabulary data, package manifests, and tests in one source root. Omit in headless without changing authoritative registration. Delegates settings-registry to @latticeaxiom/settings; its realization and trust remain data-only pending explicit native build authorization.

packages.name: @latticeaxiom/world-library
packages.v1_role: World catalog, create/continue, and recovery surface capability.
packages.notes: Owns canonical world-catalog surface-state data. It consumes latticeaxiom-world-catalog contracts and never opens a world writer; the launcher/host compatibility bridge performs the typed handoff.

packages.name: @terrenia/blocks
packages.v1_role: Terrenia block and fluid catalog, block-item mappings, physical/selection/collision semantics, and worldgen roles.
packages.notes: Owns the authored 72-block/two-fluid catalog, semantic registry, display source, and stable-ID goldens. Contains no generic inventory or mining implementation; @terrenia/tools owns tool-item identities, and the host loads this package's selected locked DataRoot instead of copying catalogs.

packages.name: @terrenia/gameplay
packages.v1_role: Terrenia drops, placement rules, recipes, and workstation/furnace/container bindings using host-agnostic sandbox contracts.
packages.notes: Owns authored gameplay rules and has an explicit @terrenia/tools dependency plus sandbox-tools capability requirement. Generic mechanics remain in latticeaxiom-gameplay; the host compiles this selected locked data rather than embedding Terrenia rule defaults.

packages.name: @terrenia/journey
packages.v1_role: Terrenia chapter and quest content over the generic progress graph.
packages.notes: Owns canonical chapter-page data and consumes @latticeaxiom/progress. Journey content does not own the generic progress runtime or host UI.

packages.name: @terrenia/metallurgy
packages.v1_role: Copper-first material and alloy table providing the Terrenia metallurgy capability.
packages.notes: Owns copper, annealed copper, bronze, and brass identities and material data. Science may consume this capability through its optional metallurgy feature; the host owns no metal enum.

packages.name: @terrenia/presentation
packages.v1_role: Client-only textures, materials, icons, display metadata, render registrations, and HUD fragments.
packages.notes: Owns the complete authored asset table, content display, natural layers, textures, and deterministic fallbacks selected by the content-presentation capability. Headless omits this package without changing authoritative registration or world hash.

packages.name: @terrenia/science
packages.v1_role: Terrenia voltage and science-processing recipe graph with optional metallurgy integration.
packages.notes: Owns science-processing and voltage state data, not mana. Its optional default metallurgy feature consumes @terrenia/metallurgy without transferring material ownership to the host.

packages.name: @terrenia/thaumaturgy
packages.v1_role: Terrenia mana state data and thaumaturgy capability.
packages.notes: Owns mana as a distinct state-property identity from science voltage. It is package-authored data and does not introduce a host-side magic enum.

packages.name: @terrenia/tools
packages.v1_role: Terrenia wooden/stone tool and item catalog providing sandbox-tools.
packages.notes: Owns stick and tool item identities, durability, class/tier predicates, display rows, and the intrinsic no-item hand fallback. It depends on @terrenia/blocks; runtime mining mechanics remain in latticeaxiom-gameplay.

packages.name: @terrenia/worldgen
packages.v1_role: Exactly-one Terrenia terrain provider: generation configuration, territories, caves, hydrology, geology, resources, vegetation, and role bindings.
packages.notes: Owns authored biome, block-binding, natural-layer, and stable-ID data and requires @terrenia/blocks. The generic algorithms live in latticeaxiom-worldgen and latticeaxiom-territory; the host must not synthesize a fallback Terrenia dimension.

packages.name: terrenia
packages.v1_role: Replaceable dimension root and namespace owner aggregating the Terrenia authoritative closure.
packages.notes: Owns the dimension registration and aggregates blocks, worldgen, gameplay, tools, and client-only presentation by explicit dependencies and capabilities. The host must not contain a hidden Terrenia plugin list or package-name fallback; headless projection omits presentation.
